This page lists 45 TablePlus keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `tableplus.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in TablePlus to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t tableplus.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/tableplus.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/TablePlus.app`; if TablePlus lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Global

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘N` | Open a new connection |
| `⌘,` | Open Preference |
| `⌘Q` | Quit app |
| `⌘⇧O` | New SQL Viewer |

## Workspace

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘W` | Close tab/window |
| `⌘S` | Commit the changes |
| `⌘⇧P` | Preview the changes |
| `⌘⇧⌫` | Discard the changes |
| `⌘T` | Open a new tab |
| `⌘L` | Open plugin manager |
| `⌘⇧C` | Toggle console log |
| `⌘.` | Run custom script |
| `⌘R` | Reload workspace |
| `⌘[` | Navigate to left tab |
| `⌘]` | Navigate to right tab |
| `⇧⌘[` | Navigate to left Pane |
| `⇧⌘]` | Navigate to right Pane |
| `⌘⇧D` | Split Pane Horizontally |
| `⌘1-9` | Navigate to number tab |
| `⌘K` | Switch database |
| `⌘⇧K` | Switch Connection |
| `⌘Z` | Undo |
| `⌘⇧Z` | Redo |
| `⌘P` | Open anything |
| `⌘E` | Open SQL Query |

## SQL Tab

In SQL editor tab.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘⏎` | Execute SQL Code |
| `⌘O` | Open file SQL |
| `⌘I` | Beautify selected SQL statements |
| `⇧⌘I` | Uglify selected SQL statements |
| `⇧⌘S` | Save selected SQL as |
| `⌘/` | Comment/Uncomment lines of SQL |
| `⌘+click` | Add cursors at arbitrary positions |
| `⌃⇧↑` | Add cursor above current line |
| `⌃⇧↓` | Add cursor below current line |
| `⌘D` | Select next instance of highlight |
| `⌘⌃G` | Select all instances of highlight |

## Table Data

When viewing table data.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Space` | Toggle row detail (row selected) |
| `⌘C` | Copy rows |
| `⌘V` | Paste rows |
| `⌘D` | Duplicate row |
| `⌘I` | Insert a new row |
| `⌘F` | Open Row Filter |
| `⌘⌥F` | Open Column Filter |
| `⌥+click` | Open Quick edit Menu |
| `⇥` | Move focus while editing |

## Template file

The full [`tableplus.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/tableplus.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
